Package domain

Class LightningShot

java.lang.Object
domain.LightningShot
All Implemented Interfaces:
PowerShot, Serializable
public class LightningShot extends Object implements PowerShot
Lightning, the shot of Cameroon: straight and covered with electricity. If it hits the rival, the rival is electrocuted.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
